splits.name: Upper / Lower
splits.summary: Alternates upper-body days with lower-body days.
splits.organisation: Upper days: chest, back, shoulders and arms. Lower days: thighs, hips, calves and core.
splits.days: 4 days a week, or a rotation over 2–3
benefits: Each muscle group is usually trained twice a week on four days.
Sessions stay shorter than full-body sessions with the same weekly volume.
limitations: Fits less well when only two days are reliably available.
A missed day leaves half the body untrained until the next rotation.

cues: Feet planted, shoulder blades pulled back
Lower the bar under control to the lower chest
benefits: Lets load be added in small steps over time
Trains chest, shoulders and triceps together
limitations: Needs a rack and ideally a spotter or safety arms
Fixed bar path; some people find dumbbells more comfortable for their shoulders

cues: Bar on the upper back, brace before each rep
Sit down between the hips to a depth you control
benefits: Trains the whole lower body in one movement
Lets load be added in small steps over time
limitations: Needs a rack with safety arms
Technique takes practice; a goblet squat is easier to learn

terms.text: Three sets, each of 8 to 12 repetitions. When every set reaches the top of the range with good form, a slightly harder version or load is the usual next step.
